segments.ja515:2.1: Dhammena no adhammena, adhammo me na ruccati;
segments.ja515:2.3: Kiccova dhammo carito, rañño hoti sucīrata.
segments.ja515:3.1: Idha cevāninditā yena, pecca yena aninditā;
segments.ja515:3.3: Yasaṃ devamanussesu, yena pappomu [pappemu (sī. aṭṭha.)] brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:4.3: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, brāhmaṇakkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja515:5.3: Yaṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, kattumicchasi khattiya.
segments.ja515:6.1: Ehi kho pahito gaccha, vidhurassa upantikaṃ;
segments.ja515:6.3: Nikkhañcimaṃ [nikkhaṃ ratta (sī.), nikkhamimaṃ (pī.)] suvaṇṇassa, haraṃ gaccha sucīrata;
segments.ja515:8.5: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, vidhurakkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja515:9.1: Gaṅgaṃ me pidahissanti, na taṃ sakkomi brāhmaṇa;
segments.ja515:9.3: Apidhetuṃ mahāsindhuṃ, taṃ kathaṃ so bhavissati.
segments.ja515:9.5: Na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ, atthaṃ dhammañca pucchito;
segments.ja515:10.1: Bhadrakāro ca me putto, oraso mama atrajo;
segments.ja515:10.3: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:12.5: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, bhadrakāra pabrūhi [bravīhi (sī. pī.)] me.
segments.ja515:13.3: Na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ, atthaṃ dhammañca pucchito.
segments.ja515:14.1: Sañcayo [sañjayo (sī. syā. pī.)] nāma me bhātā, kaniṭṭho me sucīrata;
segments.ja515:14.3: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:15.3: Tamaddasa mahābrahmā, nisinnaṃ samhi vesmani [parisati (syā.), parīsati (pī.)].
segments.ja515:16.5: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, sañcayakkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja515:17.1: Sadā maṃ gilate [gilatī (sī.), gilati (pī.)] maccu, sāyaṃ pāto sucīrata;
segments.ja515:17.3: Na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ, atthaṃ dhammañca pucchito.
segments.ja515:18.1: Sambhavo nāma me bhātā, kaniṭṭho me sucīrata;
segments.ja515:18.3: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:19.1: Abbhuto vata bho dhammo, nāyaṃ asmāka ruccati;
segments.ja515:19.3: Tayo janā pitāputtā, tesu paññāya no vidū.
segments.ja515:20.1: Na taṃ sakkotha akkhātuṃ, atthaṃ dhammañca pucchitā;
segments.ja515:20.3: Kathaṃ nu daharo jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca pucchito.
segments.ja515:21.1: Mā naṃ daharoti uññāsi [maññāsi (syā. ka.)], apucchitvāna sambhavaṃ;
segments.ja515:21.3: Pucchitvā sambhavaṃ jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:23.3: Mā naṃ daharoti uññāsi, apucchitvāna sambhavaṃ;
segments.ja515:23.5: Pucchitvā sambhavaṃ jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:24.1: Yathāpi rammako māso, gimhānaṃ hoti brāhmaṇa;
segments.ja515:25.3: Mā naṃ daharoti uññāsi, apucchitvāna sambhavaṃ;
segments.ja515:25.5: Pucchitvā sambhavaṃ jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:26.5: Osadhehi ca dibbehi, disā bhāti pavāti ca.
segments.ja515:27.3: Mā naṃ daharoti uññāsi, apucchitvāna sambhavaṃ;
segments.ja515:27.5: Pucchitvā sambhavaṃ jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:28.3: Jalamāno vane gacche [caraṃ kacche (pī.)], analo kaṇhavattanī.
segments.ja515:29.3: Nisīthe [nissīve (syā.), nisive (ka.)] pabbataggasmiṃ, pahūtedho [bahutejo (syā. ka.)] virocati.
segments.ja515:30.3: Mā naṃ daharoti uññāsi, apucchitvāna sambhavaṃ;
segments.ja515:30.5: Pucchitvā sambhavaṃ jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:31.1: Javena bhadraṃ jānanti, balibaddañca [balivaddañca (sī. pī.)] vāhiye;
segments.ja515:32.3: Mā naṃ daharoti uññāsi, apucchitvāna sambhavaṃ;
segments.ja515:32.5: Pucchitvā sambhavaṃ jaññā, atthaṃ dhammañca brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja515:34.5: Taṃ tvaṃ atthañca dhammañca, sambhavakkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja515:35.1: Taggha te ahamakkhissaṃ, yathāpi kusalo tathā;
segments.ja515:35.3: Rājā ca kho taṃ jānāti, yadi kāhati vā na vā.
segments.ja515:36.3: Mā katvā avasī rājā, atthe jāte yudhiṭṭhilo.
segments.ja515:37.3: Kummaggaṃ na niveseyya, yathā mūḷho acetaso [acetano (ka.)].
segments.ja515:38.3: Atitthe nappatāreyya, anatthe na yuto siyā.
segments.ja515:39.1: Yo ca etāni ṭhānāni, kattuṃ jānāti khattiyo;
segments.ja515:39.3: Sadā so vaḍḍhate rājā, sukkapakkheva candimā.
segments.ja515:40.1: Ñātīnañca piyo hoti, mittesu ca virocati;
segments.ja515:40.3: Kāyassa bhedā sappañño, saggaṃ so upapajjatīti.
